law_name: Law of Turkmenistan No. 257-IV of January 10, 2012 on Copyright and Related Rights (as amended by Law No. 668-V of 25 Nov 2017)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Art. 23(1), subject to exceptions in Art. 23(2)-(5))
notes: Entered into force 20 Jan 2012; WIPO Lex marks the 2012 text as superseded by an amended version (2017, adds Art. 8-1 on registration); Berne Paris Act accession 29 Feb 2016, in force 29 May 2016; WCT/WPPT/TRIPS unconfirmed
